correctness.rationale: Eliminating the source hyperplane equation gives the two stated quadrics in \(\mathbb P^4\). A fresh exact symbolic reconstruction of the Jacobian rank-drop ideal on all five standard affine charts leaves exactly the two claimed projective singular points. Local elimination at each point has nondegenerate quadratic Hessian, so both are ordinary double points. A prime \((2,2)\) complete intersection with only those rational double points is normal and adjunction gives a quartic del Pezzo surface. Fresh exact matrix reconstruction also reproduced \(54\mu^2(\lambda-\mu)^2(\lambda+4\mu)\) for the pencil discriminant.
